The '''''Broken 'Spanner''''' was a modified [[TL-1800 transport|TL-1800 freighter]] that was owned for over three decades by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Tiv Pocarno|Tiv "Poke" Pocarno]] and then by [[Torel Vorne]].

==History==
[[Tiv Pocarno|Tiv "Poke" Pocarno]], a former [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] pilot dishonorably discharged, used his savings to buy this [[Suwantek Systems]] [[TL-1800 transport|TL-1800 freighter]]; at that point, the ship was already broken-down and badly maintained. Under Pocarno's ownership, it was ineptly upgraded and modified at great expense by [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw techs]]. Pocarno used the ship to sell weapons to pirates and revolutionaries for thirty years, but he got only a slight profit from it.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

Pocarno then asked [[Torel Vorne]], a crimelord from [[Reuss VIII/Legends|Reuss VIII]], for a loan, and then tried to raise money with a smuggling run off [[Rampa III]] to pay it off. Pocarno failed to pay and was killed by Vorne. Vorne then impounded the ship and had it partially repaired; from then on, the ship could at least make a run, although it still required constant maintenance and required a new port-side cargo pod capture mechanism.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

==Modifications==
The ''Broken 'Spanner'' was illegally modified to drastically increase the ship's sublight speed. A number of weapons were also added, and the shield generators were replaced with a package from an Imperial gunboat. The ship also had a number of smuggling compartments installed. The ad-hoc nature of these modifications increased the ship's maintenance requirement; the navigation systems in particular were rendered unreliable.<ref name="Stock Ships" />
